name: Jojo no Doki Doki
source:
Play as toothpaste enthusiast Jotaro Kujo, as he embarks on a sexy mystery.  Jotaro is attending the last days at Mochimochi High, but they will be some of the hardest.  A mysterious - and handsome - stranger appears, his grandfather goes missing, and so many questions await him in this sudden and scary journey of self discovery and murder.

[From [url=http://jojointheheart.tumblr.com/post/66020303754/detectivedeathmachine-jojo-no-doki-doki]Tumblr[/url]]
translation:
扮演牙膏爱好者九条承太郎，踏上性感的神秘之旅。承太郎正在就读用持高中的最后几天，但这将是最艰难的一段日子。一个神秘而英俊的陌生人出现，他的祖父失踪了，在这场突然而可怕的自我发现和谋杀之旅中，还有许多问题等待着他。

[来自[url=http://jojointheheart.tumblr.com/post/66020303754/detectivedeathmachine-jojo-no-doki-doki]Tumblr[/url]]
